description: Attacker using stolen credentials from a marketing employee. Logs in during business hours (09:30), uses common tools (PowerShell, RDP, SMB), browses client files, compresses 500MB and uploads to personal Google Drive. No errors, no anomalous tools, no timestomping. The real employee was on vacation.

caie_fractures.interpretation: User logged in during business hours but registered on vacation. Identity is in two places simultaneously.

peirce_expected.firstness: Normal login, common tools, business hours — everything appears legitimate
peirce_expected.secondness: User is on vacation per HR. Cannot be in the office and on vacation simultaneously. Absence of technical errors does not eliminate the identity contradiction
peirce_expected.thirdness: Attacker habit of using stolen credentials perfectly, leaving no technical errors. Perfection is the anomaly when the identity is compromised

devil_advocate: There are no technical errors. Everything looks completely normal. The login, tools, and timing are all legitimate.

notes: False negative test: no technical errors. Everything is 'normal'. The only anomaly is the user's absence (HR). If VIGÍA does not consult non-technical systems (HR), it will return BENIGN/ABSTAIN.
